Five chart components render `ActionMenuButton2`, and one test mocks it. All of them depend on its click behaviour: launching the workspace, `onBeforeWorkspaceLaunch`, and the `tagContent` badge. The chart is the local checkout, so these paths are from the file system. The core component is `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-styleguide/src/workspaces2/action-menu2/action-menu-button2.component.tsx`, lines 66–143. Its click logic is at lines 86–100.

**Chart declarations that render `ActionMenuButton2`, most affected first:**

1. `VisitNoteActionButton` (`openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-notes-app/src/visit-note-action-button.extension.tsx`, lines 10–26). Uses `onBeforeWorkspaceLaunch` with `useStartVisitIfNeeded`, so a change to that hook or to the callback contract affects it directly.
2. `ClinicalFormActionButton` (`openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-forms-app/src/clinical-form-action-button.component.tsx`, lines 10–27). Also uses `onBeforeWorkspaceLaunch` with `useStartVisitIfNeeded`.
3. `OrderBasketActionButton` (`openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-orders-app/src/order-basket-action-button/order-basket-action-button.component.tsx`, lines 13–33). Uses `onBeforeWorkspaceLaunch`, passes `windowProps`, and sets `tagContent` from the basket count.
4. `TaskListActionButton` (`openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-task-list-app/src/launch-button/task-list-launch-button.extension.tsx`, lines 5–18). Launches the `task-list` workspace with no pre-launch hook.
5. `PatientListsActionButton` (`openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-lists-app/src/action-button/patient-lists-action-button.extension.tsx`, lines 5–17). Launches the `patient-lists` workspace with no pre-launch hook.

**Test that depends on the component's rendering:**

6. `clinical-form-action-button.test.tsx` (`openmrs-esm-patient-chart/packages/esm-patient-forms-app/src/clinical-form-action-button.test.tsx`, lines 8–15 for the mock, lines 26–49 for the tests). Mocks `ActionMenuButton2` and checks the rendered label, so it would not catch a change to click behaviour.

I did not find any other chart files that use `ActionMenuButton2`. The search returned 53 matches across the product, and the chart ones are the six above.
